title: [Feature][PCP] Support fixed-K speculative decode request sharding
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Enable PCP decode request sharding with fixed-K speculative decoding. The target uses PCP sharding while the draft continues to run a replicated global batch.

- Expose consistent global token extents, request boundaries and hidden states at the PCP restoration boundary while preserving the target's graph inputs.
- Pad FULL MLA/GQA draft metadata for DP dummy execution as well as real requests; both CPU and GPU query boundaries cover the selected graph.
- Rebuild global draft attention metadata for sharded MLA/GQA targets using FULL graphs. Describe graph padding with zero-KV dummy requests and keep CPU/GPU query boundaries consistent.
- Synchronize replicated DSpark draft batches independently across DP ranks, matching the existing MTP/Eagle behavior.
- Preallocate the DeepSeek V4 MTP residual buffer before compilation so graph replay and draft restoration use the same storage.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Fixed-K speculative decoding can use PCP decode sharding with supported graph modes. No new configuration options are introduced. The draft remains replicated.

### How was this patch tested?

- Latest revision `0a524ae30`, rebased onto main `7fa6b34dc`: initialize replicated_pcp=False in the DCP speculator test fixture, which bypasses __init__. The previous CPU CI failure was reproduced as 19 failing cases; all 281 related tests passed remotely after the one-line fixture repair and rebase. No additional runtime change was made for this CI failure. Latest CI is pending.

- Latest update `9fd91c25e`: reproduced a DP2 x TP2 x PCP2 MLA/MTP FULL-graph failure in runtime dummy execution (`actual_seq_lengths=8`, query T=16). After the fix, both FULL_DECODE_ONLY and eager completed balanced (4/4 requests), uneven with an idle DP rank (1/4), and mixed queued batches (7/3). Target and draft graph replay were observed. Small random dummy-weight model, fixed-K=3, input lengths 1-960; functional coverage only.
- All 243 relevant remote unit tests passed, including dummy-padding CPU/GPU boundary consistency and existing real-request regressions. Latest CI is pending.

- Latest update `c2b5263a4` rebased onto main `03f31cfb8`: 238 relevant unit tests passed remotely. Before the fix, the DSpark regression reproduced the upstream assertion when four global draft requests reused a target sync covering two requests; the non-PCP control passed.
- A remote two-process Gloo probe passed balanced, uneven, idle-rank and eager-fallback DP synchronization cases using the upstream dispatch helper. Graph selection was mocked; this is not an end-to-end DSpark NPU model inference test. DSpark multi-DP NPU model execution remains unverified; the MLA/MTP coverage is described above.
- CI for the latest update is queued; the results below refer to the previous revision.

- All CI checks passed on `f879386ed`: 31 successful checks and 5 skipped checks, including CPU unit tests for vLLM main and `v0.30.0` and the selected NPU tests.
- 185 relevant unit tests passed in a remote Ascend container:

  ```bash
  pytest -q tests/ut/worker/test_pcp_manager_v2.py \
    tests/ut/worker/test_mtp_pcp_speculator_v2.py \
    tests/ut/worker/v2/test_speculator.py
  ```

- Remote MLA/MTP regression tests passed with PCP sharding in both `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` (capture sizes `[8, 16]`) and eager mode: short single request, long single request, mixed three requests and mixed seven requests. The original FIA query-length mismatch did not recur. These tests used a small random model with dummy weights and validate functional execution and metadata layout, not numerical accuracy.
- Local Ruff and diff checks passed.

The remote runtime used [vLLM commit ced6857](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607). The latest parent-restoration refactor was checked with the 185 unit tests; the preceding production revision passed the MLA runtime cases above. Earlier real-model comparisons had unresolved mixed-batch output differences, so complete numerical equivalence is not claimed.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607
